title: Updating the Input Pointer
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a nine-register state and let $z\in\mathbb{N}$. Replacing coordinate $0$ of its register vector by $z$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its input-pointer register by $z$.
replaced:
For a nine-register record $\sigma$ and $z\in\mathbb{N}$, updating coordinate $0$ of its
register vector to $z$ gives the register vector of the record obtained by replacing its
input-pointer register with $z$.
